boxes.desc: White Volkswagen Type 2 camper van viewed from a 45-degree elevated isometric angle, black window trim, roof rack loaded with luggage, rear-mounted spare tire, clean retro illustration style with thick outlines and muted colors.
Collection of camping luggage secured on the camper roof rack, including black, beige, white, orange, blue, and olive storage cases and travel bags arranged in neat rows.
Orange and black vintage touring motorcycle mounted on a rear carrier rack attached to the camper van.
Closed beige outdoor parasol with a black circular base positioned beside the camper van.
Beige and olive green dome camping tent with open entrance flap, illustrated in a retro outdoor catalog style.
Green folding camping chair with metal frame positioned in front of the tent.
Round charcoal barbecue grill with black frame and glowing orange food items cooking on the grate.
Large bold black sans-serif headline centered at the top of the poster, stacked on two lines.
Medium-size black Chinese subtitle centered beneath the main headline.
Large bold stencil-style numerals inside a rectangular frame near the bottom center.
Black uppercase sans-serif event title centered beneath the year.
Volkswagen circular VW emblem displayed on the rear section of the camper van.
A golden-white border collie is lying on the ground

widgets_values: An isometric vintage camping festival poster featuring a white Volkswagen Type 2 camper van surrounded by outdoor camping equipment, rendered as a retro screen-printed illustration with bold typography and minimalist geometric composition.
